oslo-norway-scenic-roads-lysefjord-and-s.speedBand: 50–80 km/h riding core, local limits always win

sections.advice: Treat High point in Røyken → Sandvika as bend craft. Brake early, look high through the turn, and keep throttle changes gentle. It is more satisfying to link ten clean bends than rescue one silly one.

Scenic stretch near Vik → Photo stop near Grua is the reward section in Oslo. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

sections.to: Near Aursmoen, on the way back
sections.advice: Photo stop near Grua → Near Aursmoen, on the way back is shade riding: beautiful, cooler and sometimes slick. Expect damp patches, leaves, gravel and wildlife where the trees meet the road.

sections.from: Near Aursmoen, on the way back

sections.advice: Food stop near Aursmoen → Back to Lysefjord is the logistics leg. Watch junctions, villages and speed changes, then let the roadbook do its job: move you out of the clutter without spending your best attention too early.

safetyMarkers.note: Respect posted limits and assume enforcement near villages, viewpoints and main-road joins.

scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 18 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

legend-normandy-cider-route.slogan: Normandy Cider Route – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-normandy-cider-route.story: official tourism route. orchards, half timbered villages, farm country. From Cambremer it runs 26 km to Trouville-sur-Mer; allow about 28 min of riding. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Normandy Cider Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 8 km this is Normandy Cider Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
